What is an Odoo Dynamic Dashboard?

A Dynamic Dashboard in Odoo is more than a static report. It is an interactive board of KPIs, charts, lists, and filters that updates with your live ERP data. Managers can change date ranges, drill into records, and share the same board with their team — ideally without writing custom code for every new chart.

What to look for in 2026

1. Real Dashboard Builder, not one fixed screen

The best Odoo Dashboard Builder lets you drag widgets, resize layouts, apply themes, and create multiple boards for different roles (CEO, sales manager, warehouse lead).

2. AI that assists — without locking you in

An AI Dashboard should generate useful widgets from a business keyword like “Sales” or “Overdue invoices by salesperson”, then let you preview before saving. Prefer solutions where you bring your own API key (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Cursor) so billing and data policy stay under your control.

3. Enough visualizations for real decisions

Bar / line / pie alone are not enough. Look for KPI tiles, funnels, gauges, heatmaps, maps, scorecards, lists, and multi-series charts — typically 50+ styles if you want one module to cover every department.

4. Multi-source data

Strong Dynamic Dashboards connect Odoo models, Custom SQL, Visual Query Builder, Excel/CSV, Google Sheets, APIs, and external databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).

5. Sharing and TV Mode

Offices still run on wallboards. TV Mode, Present Mode, secure share links, exports (PNG/PDF/Excel/CSV), and scheduled email reports turn a dashboard into daily habit — not a forgotten menu item.

Department dashboards you should be able to build

  • Sales Dashboard — revenue, quotations, win rate, team mix
  • CRM Dashboard — pipeline, funnel, activities
  • Inventory Dashboard — on-hand, low stock, warehouse load
  • Accounting Dashboard — AR/AP, cash, P&L bridge
  • Purchase / HR / Project Dashboard — spend, headcount signals, delivery health

How Odoo Dynamic Dashboard with AI fits

Community vs Enterprise vs Odoo.sh

Third-party dashboard apps install on Community, Enterprise on-premise, and Odoo.sh. Odoo Online (SaaS) does not allow custom modules — so if you need a true Dynamic Dashboard beyond native views, plan for Community / Enterprise / Odoo.sh hosting.

Quick checklist before you buy any Odoo Dashboard app

  • Does the listing clearly support Odoo 19?
  • Can you create multiple custom boards (not only one demo screen)?
  • Are AI costs transparent (your key vs vendor subscription)?
  • Is there SQL / advanced data access when standard models are not enough?
  • Can you share boards and display them on TV?
  • Is support contact visible before purchase?
